card.name: Linking words before past years or events
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (a colon, to, of, the, in, this) that come just before a year, era, past event or comparison. Mostly in news and web text about history, disasters and statistics.

modes.label: Colon after a title
modes.description: A colon right after a heading about an event or observance, before the subtitle.
